title: 1 Chronicles
author: Traditionally associated with Ezra or the Chronicler.
date: Written after the exile to encourage restored Israel.
audience: The returned community of Israel, reminding them of their identity, worship, and Davidic hope.
historicalSetting: First Chronicles retells Israel's history with emphasis on genealogy, David, temple worship, and God's covenant promises.
keyVerse: 1 Chronicles 16:34 — "Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever."
christFocus: The focus on David and temple worship points forward to Christ, the true Son of David and the One in whom God's presence is fully revealed.
outline: Temple preparation and worship order — 1 Chronicles 21-29
